firstScreen.notes: dist/index.html: h1 'Shade gardens for Savannah’s live oaks' (6 words, trade+city+outcome). Proof line '14 years in Savannah · Sample 4.9 (64 reviews)'. Two distinct CTAs (Call to plan / Text a photo). Phone visible in header. Arch-masked hero with clip-path reveal. Next band peeks.

distinctiveness.notes: Botanical Plant Marker signature in 5 sections: hero (marker--hero), services (marker--card), story (inline marker), reviews (marker--tag), footer/area (marker--pill). Palette Live Oak + Lantern Gold unique. Type pair Cormorant/Albert differs from siblings A and B. -0.5: services grid shape is conventional 3-col.

type.notes: Fluid clamp scale. Body >=16px. Measure 62ch/34ch. Tabular nums in estimator. Lead paragraph styled. Display tracking -.02em. No orphans. Curly quotes in reviews. Only 2 families.

layout.notes: 11 sections with tone alternation deep/light/paper/deep/light/paper/paper/light/accent/deep/light/deep. Full-bleed break. Asymmetric split-story. -0.5: story and season both t-paper similar density. -0.5: 9-card services grid dense. -0.5: footer areas redundant with area section.

photo.notes: All placeholders. Slots appropriate to brief (hero-C2, region-savannah-street, process-planting). Alt text descriptive. Width/height/lazy present. Cannot verify grade/crop without screenshots; capped at 8.0.

copy.notes: Specific Savannah nouns (cast iron plant, muhly grass, tabby paths). Sample labels on reviews/pricing. Microcopy at ZIP/form/estimator. -0.5: inconsistent primary action naming (Call to plan / Get a quote / Send request / Price it). -0.5: service blurbs verbatim from facts.

mobile.notes: Mobile bar Call+Text min-height 48px, hides on scroll. Header collapses <900px. Grid breakpoints 640/900/1100. Touch targets >=48px. h1 <=4 lines at 390. No horizontal scroll risk.

a11y.notes: Skip link, 3px focus ring, reduced motion pauses dapple/reveals. JS-off fallbacks for tabs/filter/menu. Labels on inputs. aria-live on ZIP/estimator. -0.5: Gloria F. review has 5 star SVGs but aria-label says 4 stars. -0.5: inline SVG star repetition error-prone.

motion.notes: Intro clip-path + split-text stagger. Scroll reveals + staggers. Dappled light CSS animation on t-deep (8s, paused reduced-motion). Btn press scale. Lenis loaded. Three hooks beyond plain reveals. No scroll-jack or bounce.

wow.notes: Plant Picker + Season Planner tied to thesis, hand off to form. Estimator with sample ranges. Signature extends to tool outputs. -0.5: plant picker output cards not styled as markers.

polish.notes: SVG favicon + apple-touch. OG 1200x630. JSON-LD. Theme-color. Print stylesheet for estimator. Consistent radius 3px. Single shadow. Icon strokes consistent. Forced colors handled. Footer designed.

elevate.move: Insert a narrow atmospheric photo strip or t-deep quote break between service card groups to break the dense 9-card grid rhythm and restore tonal contrast mid-section.
Restyle plant picker output cards using the .marker primitive so the tool result is visually identical to the signature system, making the interactive moment inseparable from the design identity.
